description: This is a PHP source file implementing a controller class named ChannelPostsAdminController within the Goteo project. It manages administrative actions related to channel posts, including listing, adding, and deleting posts associated with specific nodes (channels). It defines routes for these actions and handles user permissions, database interactions, and response rendering.

classes.name: ChannelPostsAdminController
classes.description: Controller class for managing channel posts within the admin interface, providing listing, addition, and deletion functionalities for posts associated with specific channels.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name for this controller, which is 'channels'.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines and returns the routing configuration for the controller's actions, including the root, list, add, and delete routes.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles listing posts for a specific channel node, including pagination and error handling if the node does not exist.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles adding a post to a channel node, checking permissions, processing form submissions, and providing user feedback.

methods.name: deleteAction
methods.description: Handles deleting a specific post from a channel node, with permission checks and redirection.
